blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Mars Alba admitted that emotions run high when facing a former team, but that has always been part of her game as the Akari setter plays with swagger. Alba sealed the win with a clutch solo block against former teammate Sisi Rondina, then celebrated by pointing skyward with a confident smile as the Chargers survived Choco Mucho in five sets, 25-19, 22-25, 25-21, 19-25, 16-14, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday night at Philsports Arena. “For me, it’s normal to have high emotions.
